mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which increase risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias; fluoxetine also carries QT prolongation risk, compounding cardiac toxicity.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes closely if co-administration is necessary; consider alternative antiviral if possible; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation during foscarnet therapy.
